caption:
You get paid 26 times a year. Your bills come 12 times. 🗓️
That's 2.17 paychecks a month on average, and in two months a year you usually get a third one.
Most people let that extra check disappear.
What would you do with a bonus paycheck?
first_comment: Do you get paid weekly, biweekly or monthly? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Biweekly pay? Send this to someone who gets paid the same way. @paychecktruths
